name: Highfen
tagline: The walled capital at the heart of the realm: a round city of soot-dark stone, the palace at its centre, the Guild of Knights, a market by the gate and houses ringing the wall.

buildings.name: Highfen Palace
greet: The King's throne room. Mind the carpet, it is older than you.
His Majesty hears petitions on feast days. Today is not a feast day.
The Knights keep the roads; the palace keeps the Knights. That is the order of things.
buildings.note: 0.3.11 the palace and throne room at the heart of Highfen (designer art palace)

buildings.name: Highfen Town Hall
greet: Deeds, tithes and petitions. Take a number; there are no numbers.
The Reeve keeps the city's ledgers. All of them. Mostly.

buildings.name: Highfen Cathedral
buildings.note: 0.3.11 Highfen gets a church (designer church art)

buildings.name: Guild of Knights
greet: The Guild of Knights. We keep the roads between the cities.
Prove your steel in the wilds and the Guild will remember your name.
Wipe your boots. This floor has seen better knights than you, and muddier.
buildings.note: 0.3.11 the Guild of Knights; the id contains 'guild' so the guild music slot plays inside
